If you recall, Jax was missing his tail in Episode 5, then he got it back in Episode 6, still had it in Episode 7 and 8, and now it seems to be gone again. 

The main theory behind this seems to be that he loses his tail when under stress, and even though they all accepted Jax in Episode 8, he’s still distancing himself.

snippet.title: What Happens After Abstraction in TADC?
snippet.description:
What actually happens to characters after they abstract in The Amazing Digital Circus?


 When someone's mind finally breaks they transform into a black shapeless creature covered in eyes. They can no longer recognize anyone around them. 


They become completely aggressive and destroy everything in reach. Caine just opens a dark pit beneath the circus and throws them in. Kinger's wife Queenie is down there. Scratch is down there. 


Every single person who ever broke inside that circus is sitting in that pit right now. Unable to recognize where they are or who they were.


 And the circus keeps running above them like nothing happened. So now you know.

snippet.title: My Cat Pressed “Sad”… Here’s What Happened Next
snippet.description:
You saw the last video… the one where he kept asking where Casper was after he went back to school after the Easter break.

This is what happened next.

It didn’t stop 😅 Every morning, same question… until I started adding a distraction!

I kept modelling it back to him, same as before. Casper… work (our umbrella term for busy doing something)…Casper later. And he does understand parts of it, you can see that. But understanding doesn’t always make the feeling go away.

That’s when I gave him something else to do with it. The silvervine sticks have given him something to chew, something to focus on, something that actually helps him settle.

He stopped going back to “Casper”… and started pressing chew instead! 😁

And this is the bit I think people miss with cats… it’s not about stopping the behaviour. It’s about supporting what’s driving it so they don’t get stuck there.

The buttons didn’t just let him ask a question, they let him figure out what helped.
